name: Wireless Power Transfer Systems
description:
Introduction to wireless power transfer (WPT), far-field and near-field, and its applications
Classification of WPT systems
Inductive WPT: 
Architecture and operating principle, coupled coil modelling and design of inductive coupler, compensation networks: S-S, LCC-LCC and others, design of high-frequency inverter and rectifiers, effect of misalignment and load variation, control
Capacitive WPT:
Architecture and operating principle, capacitive coupler and compensation network design, soft switching inverters and rectifier, effect of misalignments and load variations
